post.description:
Admin-only. Resolves `pid` to an existing Player document, uploads the jersey image to S3, then creates the jersey record with jerseyImage keyed by `format` (e.g. `{ "T20": "<s3-key>" }`). On upload or creation failure after a successful S3 upload, the uploaded object is cleaned up.
Known implementation quirk: when the `image` file part is missing, the handler throws an `ApiResponse` instance instead of an `ApiError`/`HttpException`. The global exception filter does not recognize this as a typed error, so it falls through to the generic 500 Internal Server Error branch instead of returning a 400. Documented here as-is, matching the actual current behavior.

pid.description: EntitySport player id; must match an existing Player document.

format.description: Stored uppercased; used as the key under jerseyImage.

isActive.description: Defaults to true when omitted (schema default).

image.description: Jersey image file. Intended to be required - see the "Known implementation quirk" note above for what actually happens when it is missing.

400.description: Validation error (request body failed Zod validation).

401.description: Missing, invalid, or stale bearer token.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin.

404.description: No Player document found for the given pid.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Also returned when the image file part is missing, due to the implementation quirk described above.

patch.description: Admin-only. All body fields are optional - only provided fields are updated. If `pid` is provided, it is re-resolved to an existing Player document. When an `image` file part is included, `format` must also be provided in the same request (otherwise a 400 is returned) - the image is uploaded to S3, jerseyImage[format] is set to the new key, and the previous image at that format key (if any) is deleted from S3 afterward. Other formats already stored on the record are left untouched.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the jersey record.

pid.description: EntitySport player id; must match an existing Player document.

format.description: Required when image is included; identifies which jerseyImage key to set.

image.description: New jersey image file for the given format. Optional - existing images are kept when omitted.

404.description: Jersey not found, or no Player document found for the given pid.

get.description: Returns a static, in-memory list of flag codes with their CDN image URLs. Not backed by the database or EntitySport sync - the list comes from a hardcoded FLAG_CODES constant, and each URL is built by appending the code to the configured CDN base URL. Not paginated.

Admin-only. Returns a paginated list of flag records stored in the database (distinct from the public, static /cricket/flags list). Requires a valid admin bearer token that matches the single active token stored for that user.

parameters.name: filter

post.description: Admin-only. Uploads the flag image to S3, then creates the flag record. The image is required by the service layer (a 400 is thrown if the `image` file part is missing) even though it is not enforced by the request-body Zod schema itself, since the file is bound separately via a multipart FileInterceptor rather than the JSON body. `teamCode` is stored uppercased and must be unique. On upload or validation failure after a successful S3 upload, the uploaded object is cleaned up.

status.description: Defaults to active when omitted (schema default).

image.description: Flag image file. Required - a 400 is returned when missing.

400.description: Validation error, or the image file part is missing.
